k_A_gas_reaction = 0.014945922135062727
A_to_empty_rate = k_A_to_empty * a_concentration
B_to_empty_rate = k_B_to_empty * b_concentration
B_to_A_cell_rate = k_B_to_A_cell * b_concentration
A_to_B_cell_rate = k_A_to_B_cell * a_concentration
B_gas_on_A_rate = k_B_gas_reaction * b_concentration
A_gas_on_B_rate = k_A_gas_reaction * a_concentration
A_cell_laplace_loss = laplace_rate + k_A_from_single + B_to_A_cell_rate + B_gas_on_A_rate
B_cell_laplace_loss = laplace_rate + k_B_from_single + A_to_B_cell_rate + A_gas_on_B_rate
AB_cell_laplace_loss = laplace_rate + k_B_from_AB_cell + k_A_from_AB_cell + k_surface_reaction
AB_to_empty_transform_ratio = (B_to_A_cell_rate * A_to_empty_rate / A_cell_laplace_loss + A_to_B_cell_rate * B_to_empty_rate / B_cell_laplace_loss) / (AB_cell_laplace_loss - B_to_A_cell_rate * k_B_from_AB_cell / A_cell_laplace_loss - A_to_B_cell_rate * k_A_from_AB_cell / B_cell_laplace_loss)
empty_cell_transform = 1 / (laplace_rate + A_to_empty_rate + B_to_empty_rate - (k_A_from_single + B_gas_on_A_rate) * (A_to_empty_rate + k_B_from_AB_cell * AB_to_empty_transform_ratio) / A_cell_laplace_loss - (k_B_from_single + A_gas_on_B_rate) * (B_to_empty_rate + k_A_from_AB_cell * AB_to_empty_transform_ratio) / B_cell_laplace_loss - k_surface_reaction * AB_to_empty_transform_ratio)
A_cell_transform = (A_to_empty_rate * empty_cell_transform + k_B_from_AB_cell * AB_to_empty_transform_ratio * empty_cell_transform) / A_cell_laplace_loss
B_cell_transform = (B_to_empty_rate * empty_cell_transform + k_A_from_AB_cell * AB_to_empty_transform_ratio * empty_cell_transform) / B_cell_laplace_loss
AB_cell_transform = AB_to_empty_transform_ratio * empty_cell_transform
response = laplace_rate * (B_gas_on_A_rate * A_cell_transform + A_gas_on_B_rate * B_cell_transform + k_surface_reaction * AB_cell_transform)
